_doc: Game modes (GDD 3). Times are in seconds and converted to ticks (0.6 s). type drives the rule code in shared/mode_rules.gd.

clan_clash.name: Clan Clash
clan_clash.desc: Team deathmatch. First team to 50 kills, or most kills after 10 minutes.

ffa.name: Free-for-All
ffa.desc: Everyone for themselves. First to 20 kills. No third-partying: once two players fight, others can't join in for 16 ticks.

ffa_brawl.name: Brawl
ffa_brawl.desc: Free-for-All with no third-party protection. Anyone can jump into any fight.

obelisks.name: Obelisks
obelisks.desc: Hold the three obelisks. 1 point per obelisk held every 5 seconds. First to 200.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: 3v3, one life per round. Wipe the other team. Best of 7.

training.name: Proving Grounds
training.desc: Practice drills and the training dummy (U1). Not matchmade.

_playlists_doc: standard = your own unlocks. Every other playlist plays one bracket from data/brackets.json (fixed kits, U2). XP still counts.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.desc: Everyone gets the same maxed kit (was Even Ground).

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.desc: Defence 1, no plate, fixed kits (was Pure Brawl).

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: Defence 70, mid-tier fixed kits, no special-attack weapons.

lab.name: The Lab
lab.desc: Experimental: Warlord kits plus this week's mutator. Vote after each match.
